schemaNote: Each entry is keyed as "<year>|<company name as in companies.json>" and holds an array of individually-sourced facts. A fact is only added when a specific field (founders, funding, investors, geography, status) is confirmed by a named primary source: the company's own site or press release, an investor's press release, an official STATION F publication, or a relevant government registry. LinkedIn, Crunchbase, other aggregators, or inference are never used as the sole evidence for a fact.
